allVisibleCapturedMeaning: true = every quest VISIBLE to this profile was captured, completed, active, failed, or listed-but-locked, across every tab the trader shows. It does NOT mean every quest the trader has: anything still gated behind an unfinished quest or an unreached loyalty level is not on screen and is therefore not here. No trader in this collection is complete in the absolute sense.
allVisibleCapturedNote: LL1-LL4 plus the essential group were all sent.

profile.note: Confirmed PvE on 2026-08-10, and corroborated by the Fence batch, whose '[PVE ZONE]' cards carry ids that exist only in tarkov.dev's pve task list. Earlier batches were recorded as unconfirmed rather than guessed. It changes nothing in the comparisons, the three modes are identical on every field across the 483 quests they share, but provenance should say what is known.
profile.factionNote: USEC. DETERMINED FROM THE COLLECTION ITSELF, not something written down at capture time. Four quests are faction-exclusive with no counterpart id: Road Closed (USEC), Green Corridor (BEAR), Our Own Land (BEAR) and Counteraction (USEC). "Road Closed" is ACTIVE on this profile, and the wiki says outright that it is "only obtainable by USEC PMCs" with Green Corridor as its BEAR counterpart. Both BEAR-only quests are absent from Prapor's list, which was captured in full. A BEAR profile could not show Road Closed and would have to show the other two, so the reading is unambiguous.

reading: Read off the in-game quest screen. `location` is the single map the game prints in the header, which is NOT the union of the objective maps. Objective text is verbatim, including the (Optional) prefix. `availableAtLoyalty` is the loyalty tab the quest was listed under.

quests.objectivesNote: THE GAME REVEALS OBJECTIVES PROGRESSIVELY, settled in game on 2026-08-11 and this is the general rule, not a fact about one quest. A step that depends on an earlier one is not printed until the earlier one is done: the hand-over line appears only once the item is picked up. So a SHORT objective list on an active or failed quest is the screen working normally, and is NOT evidence that a source invented steps. Only a COMPLETED quest's list can be graded for length. check_observed.js enforces this. Here the missing line is "Hand over the folder", confirmed in game. The quest is FAILED, so it can never be revealed. Prapor's Big Customer showed both of its objectives while also failed because neither of them depends on the other, mark-the-vehicle does not wait on locate-the-vehicle.

quests.name: Out of Curiosity
quests.mutuallyExclusive: A THREE-WAY EXCLUSIVE CHOICE, and the sources DO record it, in a field nothing here was reading. Skier's 'Chemical - Part 4', Therapist's 'Out of Curiosity' and Prapor's 'Big Customer' carry identical objectives (locate the chemical transport on Customs, mark it), and each one's `failConditions` fails it when EITHER of the other two completes. SPT encodes the same under conditions.Fail. So the observation matches the published data exactly: this profile has both Out of Curiosity and Big Customer failed, which is what happens once Skier's version is completed. Recorded because the correction layer must not treat these as ordinary incomplete quests, they are permanently failed by design.
